arxiv.summaryZh: 针对纤维增强高性能混凝土在温度暴露下抗压强度难以预测的问题，构建含1204条实验记录的数据驱动框架，比较八种机器学习模型。梯度提升与XGBoost在未见数据上最优，R²均为0.903，梯度提升的RMSE为6.67 MPa,XGBoost的MAE为3.97 MPa、MAPE为10.60%。借助SHAP与部分依赖分析识别出温度是影响抗压强度的首要因素，其次为细骨料、减水剂、水泥用量、水胶比与含水量，并将最优模型封装为Python图形界面供快速预测。
arxiv.reason: 混凝土材料强度的ML预测，属土木垂直应用，与LLM方向无关

arxiv.title: Steering beyond Language: Improving Multilingual Training-Free Text Embeddings via Paired-Residual Subspace Removal
arxiv.abstract: While deriving text embeddings directly from frozen LLMs has emerged as a promising direction, existing methods focus almost exclusively on English, leaving multilingual settings largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual training-free text embeddings in LLMs. Our analysis reveals a language-conditioned embedding geometry in which semantically equivalent sentences remain misaligned across languages. We hypothesize that language-specific variation can be disentangled from semantic content to improve embedding quality. To this end, we propose Paired-Residual Subspace Removal (PRSR), a training-free inference-time intervention that steers LLM representations toward a more language-invariant semantic space. PRSR first constructs paired residuals from multilingual parallel sentences to capture language-specific deviations. It then estimates layer-wise low-rank subspaces from these residuals and suppresses the corresponding components in the last-token hidden states. We conduct more than 200 monolingual evaluations across 18 languages using MTEB and MMTEB, along with cross-lingual bitext mining between English and over 200 other languages. Empirical results demonstrate that PRSR consistently improves the performance of existing training-free baselines in both monolingual and cross-lingual settings across different LLMs.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越语言 Steering:通过配对残差子空间移除改进多语言免训练文本嵌入
arxiv.summaryZh: 揭示冻结LLM提取的文本嵌入存在语言条件化的几何结构，语义等价句在不同语言间不对齐，而现有免训练方法几乎只覆盖英语。提出配对残差子空间移除(PRSR):用多语言平行句构造配对残差以捕获语言特异偏移，逐层估计低秩子空间，并在末位token隐状态中抑制对应分量，属推理期免训练干预。在18种语言、200余项MTEB/MMTEB单语评测及英语与200多种语言的跨语言双文本挖掘上，PRSR稳定提升现有免训练基线的表现，适用于多语言检索与跨语言表示对齐场景。
arxiv.reason: 多语言文本嵌入的表示子空间干预，思路扎实但偏表示工程，与后训练/Agent 主线擦边

arxiv.title: Beyond SAEs: Consistent Concept Discovery with Sparse Coding
arxiv.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) explain foundation model representations by decomposing activations into sparse combinations of learned dictionary atoms. However, the learned dictionaries can vary across training runs, limiting the reliability and reproducibility of SAE-based analyses. We propose Consistent Sparse Dictionary Learning (ConSDL), which replaces the standard linear encoder with per-sample sparse coding. This is motivated by our synthetic analysis showing that coefficients from a single linear encoder pass are suboptimal compared with those obtained by per-sample optimization, suggesting that sparse coding is a reliable mechanism for dictionary learning. Across 16 synthetic settings, ConSDL achieves near-perfect dictionary and coefficient recovery. These gains translate to state-of-the-art cross-seed consistency across four vision and language settings, where ConSDL improves dictionary and coefficient consistency by 17.6% and 35.9%, respectively, over the average of six SAE baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越 SAE：用稀疏编码实现一致的概念发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）把模型激活分解为字典原子的稀疏组合，以此解释基础模型的表征，但训练得到的字典在不同随机种子下差异很大，分析结论难以复现。ConSDL 用逐样本稀疏编码替代标准线性编码器：合成实验表明，单次线性编码得到的系数不如逐样本优化，据此认为稀疏编码是更可靠的字典学习机制。在 16 组合成设定中，该方法的字典与系数恢复接近完美；在四个视觉与语言设定中，跨种子一致性达到最优，字典一致性与系数一致性分别比六个 SAE 基线均值提升 17.6% 与 35.9%。该方法适用于需要可复现的模型可解释性分析场景。
arxiv.reason: SAE 可解释性方法改进，非画像核心方向但涉及基础模型表征分析

arxiv.title: FuTransformer: FP8 prefill and INT4 decode for Llama-style inference on Hopper
arxiv.abstract: Transformer prefill reuses weights across tokens and is dominated by matrix multiplication and activation data movement; single-token decode has limited reuse and is dominated by weight and KV-cache reads. We present FUTRANSFORMER, a CUDA implementation of a Llama-style Transformer block for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. It applies CODA's GEMM-plus-epilogue approach to inference, adding direct KV-cache placement, folding the fixed RMSNorm gain into weights, writing FP8 output directly with delayed scaling, and supporting prefill without padding. Decode uses INT4 projection weights and an INT4 KV-cache copy. Weights and keys follow Tensor Core fragment layouts for direct dequantization into MMA operands without full intermediate tiles. A block-diagonal Hadamard transform reduces cache quantization error from outlier channels. On one H100, prefill is up to 1.48x faster than compiled PyTorch FP8 and reaches 1.29 PFLOP/s. For gate/up projection with SwiGLU at the 8B shape, our BF16 path is 1.13x faster than CODA. Our FP8 path is 2.02-2.18x faster than the evaluated BF16 CODA path. Across 8B and 70B shapes at batches 1-32, INT4 decode is 1.3-2.4x faster than the faster of PyTorch's BF16 and INT4 blocks at each point: 2.1-3.3x faster than compiled, CUDA-graphed BF16 and 1.3-6.3x faster than the same block using PyTorch's INT4 projection kernel, which targets a single query row and loses to BF16 at batch 32. It is also 31-51% faster than our FP8 path. Complete Llama-3.1-8B decode takes 2.8 ms per step at batch one, versus 8.1 ms for the compiled transformers implementation. Decoding every WikiText-2 token through the INT4 weight path raises perplexity from 6.24 to 7.23 with round-to-nearest weights or 6.99 with GPTQ in the same format; the rotated INT4 cache adds 0.20. The kernels match a quantized reference computation within 0.001 perplexity.
arxiv.titleZh: FuTransformer：面向 Hopper 上 Llama 风格推理的 FP8 prefill 与 INT4 decode
arxiv.summaryZh: prefill 阶段受矩阵乘和激活数据搬移主导，单 token decode 阶段受权重与 KV cache 读取主导，因此该工作在 Hopper 上实现了 Llama 风格 block 的 CUDA 内核：prefill 采用 FP8，并配合延迟缩放、直接写出输出；decode 使用 INT4 权重和 INT4 KV cache，权重与 key 按 Tensor Core fragment 布局直接反量化后送入 MMA，同时用块对角 Hadamard 变换降低离群通道带来的量化误差。在单张 H100 上，prefill 比编译后的 PyTorch FP8 快 1.48 倍，达到 1.29 PFLOP/s；在 8B/70B 形状、batch 1–32 下，INT4 decode 比 PyTorch BF16 与 INT4 block 中较快者快 1.3–2.4 倍；Llama-3.1-8B 在 batch 1 下单步耗时 2.8 ms，编译版为 8.1 ms。在 WikiText-2 上，全 INT4 权重路径的困惑度由 6.24 变为 7.23（RTN，round-to-nearest）或 6.99（GPTQ），旋转 INT4 cache 再增加 0.20。
arxiv.reason: Hopper 上 FP8/INT4 推理内核与 KV cache 量化，直接命中高效推理方向

arxiv.title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery
arxiv.abstract: Computational drug discovery requires agents to compose scientific operations and adapt to changing evidence and constraints. Here we introduce DrugHarness, an evolvable agent harness coupling composable scientific execution with conditional skill induction. Its environment integrates over 80 scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code, preserving associations among candidates, results and artifacts. From execution trajectories and outcome feedback, DrugHarness induces action hypotheses with observable applicability conditions, recommended actions and supporting evidence. An independent review agent evaluates candidate skills derived from these hypotheses through source verification and, when needed, targeted execution trials. Admitted skills guide subsequent tasks and are revised through feedback. Evaluation on MolBench and SMDD-Bench demonstrates capabilities in molecular screening, optimization and constrained design. Without evolution, DrugHarness exceeds reported MolClaw-CC results by 10.8 percentage points in affinity-comparison accuracy and 55% in mean top-three active hits on MolBench. Retrospective evaluation on skill-development tasks shows that evolution increases Qwen's affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1% and optimization success from 79.5% to 87.2%. In a prospective HPK1 study, DrugHarness achieves a more favorable median docking score than Biomni among system-specific candidates. A synthesized compound achieves a cellular IC50 of 14.19 nM, a 2.64-fold potency improvement over the best input reference, with activity competitive with two selected compounds designed by experienced medicinal chemists. These results support conditional skill evolution for scientific agents and demonstrate a workflow connecting computational drug design with experimental validation.
arxiv.titleZh: DrugHarness：一个面向计算药物发现的可进化 Agent Harness
arxiv.summaryZh: 计算药物发现要求智能体组合科学操作，并随证据与约束变化调整策略。DrugHarness 将可组合的科学执行与条件化技能归纳耦合成可进化 harness：环境集成 80 余项科学操作与生物医学资源，从执行轨迹和结果反馈中归纳带可观测适用条件的动作假设，再由独立审查智能体通过来源核验与定向试运行筛选为技能，用于指导后续任务并随反馈修订。MolBench 上不启用进化即比 MolClaw-CC 的亲和力比较准确率高 10.8 个百分点、平均 top-3 活性命中高 55%；启用进化后 Qwen 亲和力比较准确率由 62.2% 升至 81.1%，优化成功率由 79.5% 升至 87.2%，HPK1 前瞻研究中合成化合物细胞 IC50 达 14.19 nM。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 与技能进化机制扎实，但落地药物发现垂直场景

arxiv.title: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.
arxiv.titleZh: DLite:面向 Agentic AI 的无历史投机解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Agentic 工作负载中长且持续演化的上下文，现有 draft model 的接受长度最多下降 80%，而保留历史 KV cache 又带来大量系统开销。DLite 直接复用目标模型的上下文隐状态做局部投机预测，不显式维护历史，把越来越复杂的建模问题转化为局部简单预测;再用轻量 sequential head 以低开销恢复块内因果依赖，并配套两阶段训练适配这一异构无历史架构。在通用、长上下文与 Agentic 任务上取得 2–6 的接受长度，优于 SOTA 方法 DSpark 最多 70%，适用于多轮交互的 Agent 推理加速。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码结合 Agent 推理加速，命中系统与效率方向

arxiv.title: Logic-Guided Graph Denoising Diffusion Models
arxiv.abstract: Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data. However, when such distributions have strict structural constraints, diffusion models may fail to capture them exactly, resulting in the generation of invalid graphs. In this paper, we propose a method for grounding graph diffusion models in domain-specific knowledge via First Order Logic (FOL), leveraging its expressive and interpretable formalism to impose structural constraints on the generative process. We incorporate domain knowledge using classifier guidance, a technique that conditions the diffusion model's distribution on external variables to exert control over the sampled data. During the generative process, classifier guidance steers the denoising trajectory to optimize an objective function, which we define as a fuzzy and differentiable relaxation of the logical rules. Our methodology requires only the specification of constraints in FOL, whose satisfaction is encouraged at inference time to guide a pre-trained generative model. We evaluate our approach by comparing the unconditional generation of knowledge graphs with our logic-guided framework, which incorporates domain ontologies as structural constraints during inference. This approach significantly increases the proportion of generated graphs that satisfy the ontological constraints.
arxiv.titleZh: 逻辑引导的图去噪扩散模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对图扩散模型在存在严格结构约束时容易生成无效图的问题，该方法用一阶逻辑(FOL)把领域知识注入生成过程:在推理阶段以分类器引导的方式，将去噪轨迹导向一个对逻辑规则做模糊化、可微松弛得到的目标函数，从而只需给出FOL约束即可约束预训练扩散模型。在知识图谱无条件生成任务上，引入本体作为结构约束后，生成的图满足本体约束的比例显著提升。该工作面向带结构约束的图生成场景，与LLM后训练、Agent等方向无直接关联。
arxiv.reason: 图扩散模型加逻辑约束，属扩散生成方向，与LLM关注点无关

arxiv.title: Universal Semantic Enhancement for Weakly Supervised Anomaly Detection
arxiv.abstract: Weakly supervised anomaly detection on tabular data is an essential task in many label-scarce applications, since tabular data is widely encountered and it is commonly observed in practice that only a limited number of labeled anomalies are available alongside abundant unlabeled samples. Most existing methods try to learn features that capture the inherent distribution patterns in the target domain. However, such features often struggle to provide a complete description of possible abnormal characteristics and are highly susceptible to overfitting the extremely scarce labels. To address this challenge, we propose a weakly supervised anomaly detection method based on universal semantic enhancement for tabular data, which fuses the universal knowledge from a pre-trained tabular foundation model with the domain-specific knowledge learned on the target dataset. The two types of knowledge are naturally complementary: universal semantics describe the common patterns of tabular data across domains, while the domain-specific features capture the inherent distributions of normal and anomalous behaviors in the target dataset. A prototype-conditioned modulation mechanism is then designed to effectively integrate the two types of features, allowing them to reinforce each other for improved anomaly detection. Extensive experiments on public datasets show that the proposed method outperforms competitive methods when only eight labeled anomalies are available in the training procedure.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向弱监督异常检测的通用语义增强
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对表格数据标注稀缺场景下的弱监督异常检测，现有方法仅从目标域学习特征，难以完整刻画异常特性，且极易过拟合极少量标签。该方法将预训练表格基础模型的通用知识与目标数据集上学到的域内知识融合，二者天然互补:通用语义刻画跨域共性模式，域内特征捕捉正常与异常行为的固有分布;并设计原型条件调制机制整合两类特征，使其相互增强。在公开数据集上，训练中仅有八个标注异常样本时即优于同类竞争方法。适用于标签极少的表格异常检测部署场景。
arxiv.reason: 表格数据异常检测，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无关，仅沾基础模型边

arxiv.title: The Italian lawmaking process: a unified and structured dataset
arxiv.abstract: The Italian legislative process is documented in detailed parliamentary records hosted in institutional websites. However, much of this information is available only as unstructured text, limiting its systematic reuse. We applied a controlled, systematic LLM-based extraction procedure, validated against manually annotated records, to convert these texts into ordered and dated events including, e.g., bill introduction, committee examination, plenary examination, and approval. The resulting dataset reconstructs the procedural histories of all 5346 Italian laws enacted between 1985 and 2026, spanning parliamentary terms IX to XIX, for overall 101413 events. Each event records the activity, date, and chamber, with additional procedural details where available. The dataset supports research in the emerging fields of computational legal and legislative studies, potentially combined with process-oriented data science methods to examine procedural paths and legislative timing across parliamentary terms.
arxiv.titleZh: 意大利立法流程：一个统一且结构化的数据集
arxiv.summaryZh: 意大利立法过程的记录散落在议会网站的长篇非结构化文本中，难以系统复用。研究采用受控的 LLM 抽取流程，并以人工标注记录做校验，将原文转换为带序次与日期的事件（法案提出、委员会审议、全体会议审议、批准等）。数据集重建了 1985 至 2026 年间第 IX 至 XIX 届议会全部 5346 部法律的程序史，共 101413 个事件，每个事件记录活动、日期、议院及可获得的程序细节。该资源服务于计算法学与立法研究，可用于考察跨届议会的程序路径与立法时序。
arxiv.reason: LLM 抽取构建法律流程数据集，属垂直领域应用，相关度有限

arxiv.title: LagNet: Lag-Structured Operators for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: Long-term time series forecasting maps a finite history window to an extended future horizon. Many existing models focus primarily on the design of input representations and model structures, while paying less attention to the structural form of the history-to-future forecasting operator itself. We examine this operator directly and find that, across model families, sensitivity matrices exhibit recurring diagonal patterns whose diagonals correspond to relative temporal lags. Motivated by this observation, we develop a framework for direct multi-step forecasting based on lag-structured temporal operators. Its basic building block, LagLayer, constructs a Toeplitz matrix by tying history-to-future connections with the same relative lag and incorporates horizon-wise and history-wise scaling coefficients to relax exact sharing. This design enables LagLayer to serve as an effective replacement for temporal linear layers in existing forecasting models. Stacking LagLayer modules with activations and multiple feature maps yields LagNet. Experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks show that our method is competitive with strong baselines, while sensitivity matrix diagnostics and limited-data experiments demonstrate that LagLayer provides an effective and sample-efficient alternative to a linear layer.
arxiv.titleZh: LagNet：面向长期时间序列预测的滞后结构化算子
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长期时间序列预测中历史到未来的映射算子结构鲜少被直接设计的问题，考察多类模型的敏感度矩阵后发现其对角线呈现稳定的相对时间滞后模式。据此提出LagLayer：以相同相对滞后绑定历史与未来连接构造Toeplitz矩阵，并加入按预测步与历史位置的缩放系数放松严格共享，可替换现有预测模型中的时序线性层；堆叠带激活与多特征图即得LagNet。在长期预测基准上与强基线相当，敏感度诊断与小数据实验显示其作为线性层替代方案更省样本。
arxiv.reason: 时间序列预测架构改进，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无交集。

arxiv.title: Bridging the Language Gap in Scholarly Data II: Enhancing Gender Inference for Chinese Names
arxiv.abstract: Perceived gender inference from names is important for inclusive scientometrics research, yet existing methods perform poorly on non-Western scholars. We address this gap for Chinese names, which appear in two forms, Hanzi and Pinyin, its Romanized form (e.g., Zhang Wei, Li Na). In international bibliographic records, names are often available only in Pinyin. However, a single pinyin name can correspond to multiple distinct hanzi characters with different gender associations, so gender inference from Pinyin alone is intrinsically ambiguous. To address this, we first develop two hanzi models, a regression model that produces a continuous gender score from 0 (male) to 1 (female), and a classification model that outputs one of three labels (\em{male}, \em{neutral}, \em{female}). We train them on a sample of hanzi names from Chinese-language physics publications, rated by 11 native Chinese speakers. On this sample, the models achieve an RMSE of $0.09$ and an R$^2$ of $0.85$ (regression), and macro-AUC of $0.97$ and a Cohen's $κ$ of $0.81$ (classification), demonstrating high performance that is robust to class imbalance. For pinyin names, we propose a pipeline that aggregates hanzi predictions via transliteration and frequency weighting, together with an ambiguity score that flags names whose gender cannot be resolved from Pinyin alone. Benchmarked against three off-the-shelf tools (Namsor, GPT, and Claude), our models achieve the highest agreement with human annotations for both gender scores and gender labels, in both scripts. Applied to an independent sample of Chinese-named authors in APS journals, our models assign a gender to every name, whereas existing Pinyin-based methods leave between 20\% and 100\% of names unclassified. These findings demonstrate the importance of hanzi-level information for reliable gender inference of Chinese names. Code and data are publicly available.
arxiv.comment: 36 pages (13 main; 23 SI), 6 figures in main (under review)
arxiv.titleZh: 弥合学术数据中的语言鸿沟 II:增强中文姓名的性别推断
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向非西方学者姓名性别推断的短板，聚焦中文姓名汉字与拼音两种形态:国际书目记录常只保留拼音，而同一拼音对应多个性别倾向不同的汉字，仅凭拼音推断存在本质歧义。方法上先基于 11 位中文母语者标注的中文物理出版物汉字姓名样本，训练回归模型(输出 0 男性至 1 女性的连续性别分)与三分类模型(male/neutral/female)，再在拼音层提出经转写与频率加权聚合汉字预测的流水线，并给出标记无法由拼音判定者的歧义分数。汉字样本上回归 RMSE 0.09、R² 0.85，分类 macro-AUC 0.97、Cohen's κ 0.81;与 Namsor、GPT、Claude 三个现成工具对比，在两种书写形态下与人工标注一致性均最高;应用于 APS 期刊中文姓名作者独立样本时可为全部姓名判定性别，而现有基于拼音的方法有 20%–100% 姓名无法分类。
arxiv.reason: 姓名性别推断属科学计量学应用，与 LLM 核心方向交集有限

arxiv.title: Escaping Parameter Space: Tight Generalization Bounds via Representation Quality
arxiv.abstract: We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural networks based on their last hidden layer representations. By evaluating representation quality with a parameter-free $k$-nearest-neighbor ($k$-NN) classifier, our certificate avoids traditional parameter-space complexity measures, KL divergences to a posterior, weight norms, and compression. The bound is tight: trained from scratch, it reaches an 8.0 percentage point gap to test error on CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18) and yields the first non-vacuous certificates we are aware of on CIFAR-100; with frozen DINOv2 representations, it certifies at 1.4\% on CIFAR-10 and 23.1\% on 1,000-class ImageNet. It decomposes additively into three empirical, independently measurable quantities: local class geometry ($k$-NN decoder error), decoder-network agreement, and training stability. This allows the bound to act as a diagnostic tool: we demonstrate that actively destroying local class geometry eliminates generalization while leaving dataset memorization intact, identifying class geometry as a causally relevant mechanism for generalization. Finally, we show that learned representations are significantly less sensitive to weight noise than linear readouts, suggesting why parameter-space certificates often struggle to remain tight.
arxiv.titleZh: 逃离参数空间：通过表示质量得到紧致的泛化界
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对深度网络泛化界依赖权重范数、后验 KL 或压缩等参数空间复杂度度量、往往松弛的问题，改以最后一层隐藏表示的质量来刻画泛化，用无参数的 k-NN 分类器评估表示，从而完全绕开参数空间量。该界可加性分解为局部类几何（k-NN 解码误差）、解码器与网络一致性、训练稳定性三项可独立测量的经验量。ResNet-18 从零训练在 CIFAR-10 上与测试误差仅差 8.0 个百分点，并在 CIFAR-100 上首次给出非空泛化证书；冻结 DINOv2 表示时在 CIFAR-10 认证到 1.4%，1000 类 ImageNet 上认证到 23.1%。破坏局部类几何会使泛化消失而记忆保持，说明类几何是因果相关的泛化机制，该界亦可作为诊断工具使用。
arxiv.reason: 表示质量视角的泛化界理论工作，与 LLM 后训练仅有间接关联

arxiv.title: Beyond Large Language Models: A Mental World Model Framework for Mental Modeling, Simulation, Evolution, and Interpretability
arxiv.abstract: Understanding and simulating how subjective cognition and mental states emerge, evolve, and shape behavior is essential for advancing artificial intelligence toward deeper social cognition and general intelligence. Existing large language models (LLMs) and Theory of Mind (ToM) methods primarily infer mental states from linguistic information, lacking unified mechanisms for subjective world construction, cognitive-psychological interactions, dynamic evolution, and historical dependencies. This paper introduces the Mental World Model (MWM) and its implementation, the Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture (MMEA), which explicitly constructs subjective worlds, models interactions between cognition and mental states, and simulates continuous mental evolution shaped by historical experiences. On DynToM and RecToM, MMEA achieves 96.48% and 94.00% accuracy, respectively, outperforming leading LLMs and specialized ToM methods. Additional experiments demonstrate improvements of 28.7, 39.3, and 16.6 percentage points in mental state and behavior prediction, long-sequence prediction, and implicit mental state inference, respectively. The results demonstrate that MMEA provides an interpretable framework for continuous mental modeling, enabling AI to move beyond surface-level semantic representations to infer individuals' underlying mental states from linguistic information and dynamically simulate their internal cognitive processes and evolution over time. MWM also provides a promising foundation for causal reasoning, personalized AI, sustained human-AI interaction, and future advances toward artificial general intelligence (AGI).
arxiv.titleZh: 超越大语言模型：面向心智建模、仿真、演化与可解释性的心智世界模型框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有 LLM 与 Theory of Mind 方法主要从语言信息反推心理状态，缺乏主观世界构建、认知与心理交互及动态演化的统一机制。为此提出心智世界模型（MWM）及其实现多分支心智演化架构（MMEA），显式构建个体主观世界、建模认知与心理状态的相互作用，并模拟受历史经验约束的连续心智演化过程。在 DynToM 与 RecToM 上分别取得 96.48% 与 94.00% 的准确率，在心理状态与行为预测、长序列预测、隐含心理状态推断上分别提升 28.7、39.3、16.6 个百分点。该框架为可解释的连续心智建模、因果推理与长期人机交互提供了基础。
arxiv.reason: 心智理论与社会认知建模，属认知交叉方向，偏离后训练与 Agent 主线

arxiv.title: Recognizing Study Lineage Is Not Enough: Over-Crediting Same-Trial Evidence in LLM-Based Medical Verification
arxiv.abstract: Publication count is not study count. A model can identify shared trial lineage correctly in a direct task yet over-credit a second publication from the same trial when aggregating evidence. We evaluate this behavior in medical LLM verification using 14 source-audited clinical families and five model conditions. The families span provenance, clinical applicability, result direction, and composition; the provenance families provide the direct lineage tests. Recognition and aggregation are separate stateless calls, and repeated calls assess within-input stability. Across all three original provenance families, GPT-5.5 identifies the independent update in 10/10 recognition calls per family but over-credits the same-trial report in 5/5 separate aggregation calls per family. Selected Qwen3-4B and Ministral-3-8B conditions show the same cross-task contrast. A study-grouping instruction reduces GPT-5.5 over-credit from 4/5 to 0/5 in each later pure-provenance family. Other model conditions show mixed behavior, and rejected outputs limit several comparisons. The results identify a behavioral gap between elicited lineage recognition and evidence aggregation. The code and data artifacts are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/study-lineage-review-artifact.
arxiv.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables; 8 pages of main content, with references and appendices thereafter
arxiv.titleZh: 识别研究谱系并不足够:基于LLM的医学核验中过度采信同一试验证据
arxiv.summaryZh: 出版物数量不等于研究数量:模型在直接任务中能正确识别同一试验的系列发表，但在汇总证据时仍会重复采信同一试验的第二篇报告。工作构建14个经来源审计的临床家族(涵盖来源、临床适用性、结果方向与构成)，把识别与汇总拆成两次独立的无状态调用，并用重复调用检验输入内稳定性。GPT-5.5在三个来源家族中识别调用均10/10正确指认独立更新，而5/5的汇总调用仍过度采信同一试验报告;Qwen3-4B与Ministral-3-8B的选定条件呈相同跨任务反差;加入研究分组指令后，GPT-5.5在后续纯来源家族中的过度采信由4/5降至0/5。结果揭示谱系识别与证据汇总之间存在行为落差，对系统综述与医学证据核验流程中的LLM可靠性评估有直接参考价值。

arxiv.title: Neural Expansion: A Unified Mechanism for How Deep Neural Networks Generalize
arxiv.abstract: Deep neural networks demonstrate remarkable generalization despite being highly over-parameterized, challenging traditional statistical learning theories. While several theoretical paradigms such as margin-based bounds, PAC-Bayesian analyses, and neural tangent kernels provide global explanations, they often lack mechanistic insight into how generalization emerges from training dynamics. We introduce Neural Expansion, a unified geometric framework that characterizes generalization through the expansion of directionally-selective ray coverage in the input space. Using Generalization Intervals (GIs), we quantify direction-specific regions around training samples where the model's predictions remain stable. Our extensive empirical studies across diverse architectures and datasets reveal that training leads to progressive expansion of ray coverage, particularly along directions with low Jacobian singular values. This mechanism helps explain a large fraction of correctly classified test inputs, adversarial examples, and even mislabeled or out-of-distribution samples through the geometry of ray coverage rather than instance-level memorization. By connecting input-space curvature to predictive behavior, our framework provides a mechanistic foundation that complements existing global theories of deep learning.

arxiv.titleZh: 神经扩张：深度神经网络泛化机制的统一解释
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对过参数化网络泛化之谜，提出统一的几何框架「神经扩张」，用泛化区间（GI）量化训练样本周围预测保持稳定的方向性区域。跨多种架构与数据集的实验显示，训练会沿 Jacobian 奇异值较小的方向逐步扩张射线覆盖范围；该几何机制可解释很大比例的正确分类测试样本、对抗样本乃至错标与分布外样本，而非依赖逐样本记忆。工作将输入空间曲率与预测行为联系起来，为深度学习泛化提供了机制性视角，可补充边界、PAC-Bayes、NTK 等全局理论。

arxiv.title: The Cognitive Cost of LLM Writing: A Reading-Time Comparison with Human Text
arxiv.abstract: Although linguistic differences between human-written and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated texts have been extensively studied, their implications for the cognitive effort involved in reading remain less explored. In psycholinguistics, reading time is commonly used as an indirect measure of cognitive processing effort. Building on this perspective, we investigate whether human-written texts and their LLM-generated rewrites exhibit differences in predicted reading time that may reflect differences in processing demands for readers. To this end, we introduce RoBERTa-RT, a model trained on human eye-tracking data to predict word-level reading times. We evaluate the model on both internal and external test sets, construct a paired dataset of 496 human-written articles and their LLM-generated rewrites, and apply RoBERTa-RT to compare their predicted reading times. Our findings show that LLM-generated rewrites tend to be shorter and have slightly lower predicted total reading times, while exhibiting higher predicted reading times per word. These differences are associated with systematic linguistic changes, including longer and less frequent words, greater lexical diversity, and higher contextual predictability. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that LLM-generated writing may redistribute reading demands: reducing the amount of text to process while increasing the predicted processing effort associated with individual words. This highlights the importance of considering not only the linguistic characteristics of machine-generated content, but also its potential implications for human cognitive processing.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM写作的认知成本：与人类文本的阅读时间比较
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究人类文本与LLM改写文本在阅读所需认知努力上的差异，用阅读时间作为认知加工负荷的间接度量。构建基于人类眼动数据、可预测词级阅读时间的RoBERTa-RT模型，并建立496篇人类文章与其LLM改写的配对数据集进行比较。结果显示LLM改写文本更短、预测总阅读时间略低，但每词预测阅读时间更高，且伴随更长更生僻的词、更高词汇多样性与更强上下文可预测性等系统性语言变化。这表明LLM写作可能重新分配阅读负荷：减少需处理的文本量，却提高单个词的加工成本，提示评估机器生成内容时需同时考虑其对人类认知加工的影响。
arxiv.reason: 涉及LLM文本认知影响与眼动预测，但偏心理语言学，非核心方向

arxiv.title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
arxiv.abstract: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.

arxiv.titleZh: GLOBE：为生成式搜索中的电商商品优化演化结构化智能体记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 生成式搜索的商品listing优化需跨品类持续自我改进，现有方法却把结构化listing当作自由文本，策略只隐含在提示与搜索轨迹中，难以沉淀为可复用记忆。GLOBE把优化知识写成显式、按字段划分的行为手册：每轮Editor应用行为并获得排名反馈，Reflector将其转为行为更新，Moderator剔除冗余提案，Curator提交采纳改动并停用持续有害的行为，使单轮反馈变成持久的字段级记忆。实验显示结构化行为优于整体提示优化，反馈驱动的演化与审核进一步提升效果并降低下行风险，学到的行为在未见品类上仍然有效。
arxiv.reason: 智能体记忆演化与自我改进机制有新意，但属电商垂直应用且为workshop短文

arxiv.title: Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs
arxiv.abstract: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size. In paired multi-step workflows, its first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions, and against a fixed list of 100 tools it cut input tokens by 17% with Codex and 40% with Claude Code and the total bill in all 14 runs, by up to 40%, with no change in task completion.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向多步智能体的工具推荐：找到任务所需的每一个工具
arxiv.summaryZh: 多步智能体任务只要缺一个工具就会失败，而所需工具多到无法列全：被测平台约8200个工具的定义总和已超出所有受评模型的上下文窗口。系统以网关形式部署在agent与工具之间，用三个固定工具的接口暴露全部工具，每次调用在终端用户凭证下执行，并按用户对各服务的授权与智能体可用工具白名单校验。在ToolRet上，其把查询所需工具全部排进前十的比例比BM25高57%，与规模至多9倍的已发表系统相比亦不落下风；Codex会话中首次推荐即覆盖全部必需工具的比例达93%，相对固定100工具列表，输入token分别减少17%（Codex）与40%（Claude Code），14次运行总账单最多降低40%，任务完成率不变。
arxiv.reason: Agent工具检索与网关部署，方向对口但偏工程增量

arxiv.title: Blitz: Accelerating the Diffusion Modules of AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion-based protein structure prediction models produce all-atom structures in about 200 denoising steps, and that cost has driven a number of few-step samplers. We present Blitz, a few-step distillation framework that uses a geometric noise schedule to distribute steps more evenly across noise scales, then learns those updates through multistep consistency training. Physical steering and target-free candidate selection help reduce the remaining geometric defects at inference. We apply Blitz to AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2, reducing denoising from 200 steps to eight. Because published few-step results use different benchmarks and scoring procedures, we compare both distilled models with their teachers and other few-step methods under a common evaluation protocol covering structural accuracy, interface quality, ligand placement, and stereochemical validity. Blitz retains teacher-level structural accuracy, with AF3-Blitz outperforming all evaluated few-step baselines and exceeding its teacher on several accuracy metrics.
arxiv.titleZh: Blitz：加速 AlphaFold3 与 Boltz-2 的扩散模块
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散式蛋白质结构预测通常需要约 200 步去噪，成本高昂。Blitz 用几何噪声调度把采样步更均匀地分配到不同噪声尺度，再以多步一致性训练学习这些更新，并在推理阶段结合物理引导与无目标候选筛选，抑制残余几何缺陷。将该框架用于 AlphaFold 3 与 Boltz-2，可将去噪步数从 200 降至 8；在统一的评测协议下，AF3-Blitz 保持教师模型级别的结构精度，在多项指标上超过教师，并优于所有对比的少步基线。
arxiv.reason: 蛋白质结构预测的扩散加速，属生物医药方向，与 LLM 关注点无关

arxiv.title: VISTA: Steering LLMs with Latent User Values Inferred from a Few Survey Answers
arxiv.abstract: Personalizing a language model requires knowing what a person values, which stays largely consistent across tasks. Yet most methods either learn task-specific preferences or place the user's profile in the prompt, where models struggle to act on it. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition), which infers a latent profile from users' (full or partial) survey answers, and maps the profile through a hypernetwork to a user-specific steering intervention in a frozen LLM to select answer choices or generate free-text responses. Given the same evidence, VISTA matches or beats in-context profiles on synthetic preferences (Food2D), the World Values Survey (WVS), and PrimeX, without adding prompt tokens. To reduce the cognitive burden of completing full surveys, VISTA also chooses which questions to ask and when to stop: on WVS it stops after 6% of the questionnaire while retaining 94% of the full-history gain, where standard adaptive testing retains at most 42%. The dominant steering direction is an interpretable value axis on which VISTA places unseen users accurately. Our results point toward pluralistic alignment that adapts to individuals at deployable cost.
arxiv.titleZh: VISTA:从少量问卷答案推断潜在用户价值观以引导 LLM
arxiv.summaryZh: 个性化 LLM 需要掌握用户跨任务稳定的价值观，而现有做法要么学任务特定偏好，要么把用户画像塞进 prompt 而模型难以据此行动。VISTA 从用户完整或部分问卷答案推断潜在价值画像，经 hypernetwork 映射为对冻结 LLM 的用户专属 steering 干预，用于选项选择与自由文本生成。在合成偏好 Food2D、世界价值观调查(WVS)与 PrimeX 上，同等证据下效果持平或优于 in-context 画像且不增加 prompt token;在 WVS 上仅用 6% 问卷即停止仍保留全量历史 94% 的收益，而标准自适应测试至多 42%。主导 steering 方向是一条可解释的价值轴，指向可部署成本的多元对齐。
arxiv.reason: 用户价值 latent steering 做个性化对齐，属对齐方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Equivalence testing and run-count design for stochastic machine-learning experiments
arxiv.abstract: Claims that two training methods perform equally well often rest on a non-significant difference between two or three runs per method. We develop a protocol, with its power theory, for certifying practical equivalence in per-run metrics such as the AUROC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve). It rests on a two-level (seed x item) variance model separating between-run dispersion from item-level noise. Equivalence within a pre-specified margin is tested by two one-sided tests (TOST), equivalently by a confidence interval inside the margin; a two-level bootstrap covers composite statistics. A closed-form formula converts a margin and a target power into runs per method; its shifted-t refinement is calibrated against the realised two-level process. Simulations on a 270-cell grid and under non-Gaussian seed laws confirm the formula within its design-relevant range, from five runs per method. For four published runs of a joint energy-based model, the failure to certify equivalence was largely decided by design: with the variance calibrated to those runs, two per method certify with probability near three per cent, whereas certifying 0.01 AUROC at 80 per cent power needs twelve even under exact equality. A second case study on a thousand-seed CIFAR-10 zoo and the MultiBERTs checks the formula against real seed laws (within 0.05 in that range) and resolves comparisons that two or three runs leave undecided. In a two-stage design (pilot, then formula), our experiments suggest that an upper confidence bound on the pilot variance substantially reduces the undersizing seen with its point estimate.

arxiv.titleZh: 随机机器学习实验的等价性检验与运行次数设计
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对仅凭两三次运行间差异不显著就宣称两种训练方法等效的问题，提出一套带功效理论的等价性认证流程：用种子×样本两级方差模型分离运行间离散与样本噪声，以TOST和置信区间在预设边际内检验等价，并用两级bootstrap覆盖复合统计量；闭式公式把边际与目标功效换算为每种方法的运行次数，经270格模拟与真实种子律校准。案例显示，0.01 AUROC、80%功效即使完全相等也需12次运行，而两三次运行常无法判定；流程可用于随机ML实验的可靠比较与运行预算设计。
arxiv.reason: 评测可靠性方法学，非LLM专用，统计流程扎实

arxiv.title: OwlSight: A Panoramic Monitor for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments across 15,971 reasoning trajectories show that OwlSight surpasses general-purpose LLMs by 1.32-30.57 and 11.71-27.81 points at fine and coarse granularity, respectively, and achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's CoT monitorability benchmark. It also generalizes to unseen models' CoTs and remains robust to Factor rephrasings, CoT compression, and obfuscation, offering a promising paradigm for CoT monitoring that can contribute to the oversight of frontier AI.
arxiv.titleZh: OwlSight：面向思维链推理的全景监测器
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有思维链监测方法多绑定单一任务，难以覆盖推理模型的多样行为。该工作提出「Factor」机制，把监测需求写成可定制的因子放进提示词，单个监测器即可凭不同因子覆盖不同任务，并区分细粒度（如某邮箱是否泄露）与粗粒度（如隐私泄露）两类因子；据此构建的 OwlSight 仅依赖因子即可监测能力、安全与可信三个维度。在 15,971 条推理轨迹上，其细/粗粒度分别比通用 LLM 高出 1.32–30.57 与 11.71–27.81 分，并在 OpenAI CoT 可监测性基准上取得 SOTA，对未见模型的 CoT、因子改写、CoT 压缩与混淆均保持稳健。为大模型推理过程的可扩展监督提供了可配置的范式。
arxiv.reason: CoT 监测与可监测性评测，属对齐与评估方法学扎实工作

arxiv.title: TriRouter: Sparse-to-Dense Electrode-Space Routing for Robust EEG Motor Imagery Decoding
arxiv.abstract: Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages. We propose TriRouter, an electrode-space routing framework with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths. A validation-calibrated router uses observable channel availability to allocate path contributions, preserving complete-channel discrimination while increasing representation recovery under severe missingness. In BNCI2014-001, TriRouter outperforms standard public backbones and a dynamic-spatial-filtering corrupted-EEG baseline. It improves accuracy over the strongest corrupted-EEG baseline by 3.68, 4.02, and 6.46 percentage points at nominal 25%, 50%, and 75% missing settings, and remains effective under structured regional missingness and additional low-channel dataset evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: TriRouter：面向鲁棒 EEG 运动想象解码的稀疏到稠密电极空间路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 多通道 EEG 运动想象解码在实际采集中常遇到电极稀疏或损坏，导致标准模型性能明显下降。TriRouter 在电极空间构建三条路径，分别负责保持判别性、抵抗电极掩码、补全潜在表示；并借助由验证集校准的路由器，根据可观测的通道可用性分配各路径的权重。在 BNCI2014-001 上，当标称缺失率为 25%、50%、75% 时，其准确率分别比最强的受损 EEG 基线高 3.68、4.02、6.46 个百分点，并且在结构化区域缺失和低通道数据集上仍然有效。该工作面向脑机接口的鲁棒解码，与 LLM 及后训练方向无直接关联。
arxiv.reason: EEG 运动想象解码，属生物医学信号方向，与画像关注点无交集

arxiv.title: In Human Memories. Technology, Creativity and Self-Determination: An Ethical Proposal
arxiv.abstract: This research investigates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in modern compositional practices, with a particular focus on two case studies: Convergence (2020/21) by Alexander Schubert, for String Ensemble and AI System, and In Human Memories (2024) by Francesco Vitucci, for four cellos and one electroacoustic player, whose installation was created by the Electronic Music School of the "N. Piccinni" Conservatory of Bari. The initial historical survey traces the evolving use of technology in composition, revealing how the search for new expressive possibilities has driven the development of technological tools through experimentation. The appearance of AI marks a fundamental shift: no longer just a tool, AI now poses questions and challenges to the composer. Engaging with AI becomes an exploration of an unknown entity, whose full capabilities are still largely undiscovered. This new interaction leads composers to confront AI not merely as a passive resource but as a participant in the creative process, outlining an ethical path to reclaim technology as a creative tool. In Human Memories reflects this dynamic, demonstrating how AI can serve as both inspiration and a driving force in shaping contemporary music.
arxiv.comment: 19 pages, 7 figures. English translation of the article originally published in Italian in Ex Chordis, vol. 3 (2024), pp. 15-38. The Italian original is the version of record
arxiv.titleZh: 《在人类记忆中》：技术、创造力与自决——一份伦理提案
arxiv.summaryZh: 以 Alexander Schubert 的《Convergence》（2020/21，弦乐合奏与 AI 系统）和 Francesco Vitucci 的《In Human Memories》（2024，四把大提琴加一位电声演奏者）两个案例，考察 AI 在当代音乐创作实践中的角色。研究先梳理技术进入作曲的历史脉络，指出 AI 的出现使技术从被动工具变成向作曲家提问、参与创作过程的行动者，并据此提出一条把技术重新视为创作工具的伦理路径。结论落在 AI 既是灵感来源也是塑造当代音乐驱动力的判断上，属音乐创作与艺术伦理层面的人文讨论。
arxiv.reason: 音乐创作与 AI 伦理的人文学科讨论，与 LLM 方法研究无关

arxiv.title: JAXtari: High-Throughput and Easy-to-Modify Arcade Learning Environment
arxiv.abstract: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents. However, its lack of native support for object-extraction and environment modification restricts research into evaluating whether agents learn robust causal models or rely on brittle visual heuristics. Furthermore, the ALE's dependence on CPU-based emulation creates a significant bottleneck in modern GPU-accelerated training pipelines, limiting both experimental scale and iteration frequency. In this work, we introduce JAXtari, an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments. By leveraging massive GPU parallelization, JAXtari allows PPO agents to finish training on 100M environment steps on a single A100-GPU in under an hour. Beyond speed, it provides object-centric observations and a flexible modification system, allowing researchers to, e.g. develop neuro-symbolic methods or discover novel shortcuts and subsequently train and adapt their agents rapidly, sometimes in only minutes.
arxiv.titleZh: JAXtari：高吞吐、易修改的街机学习环境
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Arcade Learning Environment（ALE）依赖 CPU 模拟、缺乏对象级观测与环境改造能力这两个瓶颈，用 JAX 重新实现 Atari 2600 环境，把仿真整体放到 GPU 上做大规模并行，并提供 object-centric 观测接口与灵活的环境修改系统。PPO 智能体在单张 A100 上不到一小时即可完成 1 亿环境步的训练，环境改写后的重训与适配有时只需几分钟。该工作面向神经符号方法、捷径学习与因果表征等研究，也适用于需要高频迭代的 GPU 加速训练流水线。
arxiv.reason: GPU 并行重实现 Atari 环境，属经典 RL 基础设施，与 LLM 方向仅擦边

arxiv.title: No-Regret Language Generation
arxiv.abstract: We introduce no-regret generation, which requires a generator to make a sublinear number of mistakes uniformly over all demonstration sequences and compatible target languages. We also formulate an agnostic variant that allows arbitrary demonstrations that may not be compatible with any languages. For both settings, we introduce tree-based mistake-forcing dimensions that exactly characterize finite-horizon minimax complexity and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for no-regret generation. Our characterizations reveal a rich spectrum of generation rates: up to constant rescaling, every admissible nondecreasing profile is attainable in both the realizable and agnostic settings. Finally, we connect generation complexity to online prediction: for language classes of finite Littlestone dimension \(d\), we obtain realizable mistake bounds of \(O(d\log(1+T/d))\) and agnostic regret bounds of \(O(\sqrt{dT\log(1+T/d)})\). The realizable bound is optimal up to universal constants.
arxiv.titleZh: 无遗憾语言生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出无遗憾生成框架，要求生成器在所有示范序列与相容目标语言上犯错的次数为次线性；并给出允许任意示范的不可知变体。用基于树的错误强制维度精确刻画有限时域极小极大复杂度，给出无遗憾生成的充要条件，并证明在可实现与不可知两种设定下，任意可允许的非降速率剖面（至多相差常数缩放）均可达到。将该复杂度与在线预测联系：对 Littlestone 维数为 d 的语言类，得到 O(d log(1+T/d)) 的可实现错误界与 O(√(dT log(1+T/d))) 的不可知遗憾界，前者在通用常数内最优。
arxiv.reason: 语言生成的学习理论分析，与 LLM 工程实践交集有限

arxiv.title: Deep LLM layers expose passage-level context in EEG during silent reading
arxiv.abstract: In a previous report we showed that a decoder can recover open-vocabulary word-level information from 19-channel EEG recorded during silent reading, by aligning short EEG windows with hidden-state embeddings of the presented word taken from a large language model (LLM). That analysis contrasted two of the model's 33 layers: the context-free input embedding and one mid-depth layer. Here we ask how EEG-decodable structure is distributed over the full depth of the language model. We trained one decoder per layer of Llama-3.1-8B, with and without a causal transformer over the sequence of EEG windows. We distinguish word-level decodability from a context-tracking component. Word-level decodability peaks in early layers and declines steadily towards the last layer. In contrast, the context-tracking component of the retrieval gain rises with depth, both with and without a causal transformer. Unexpectedly, a decoder that sees a single 0.5-s window at a time tracks the text passage too. Two new controls dissect this component. A target-geometry control, a synthetic predictor made of the true target plus noise calibrated to each decoder's word-level accuracy, shows that context tracking is not a by-product of word decoding and target geometry. A control that permutes predictions across runs from either the same or from different sessions shows that most of the observed context-tracking is not caused by an EEG recording session signature. Instead, context tracking mostly follows the text. A single EEG window therefore carries passage-level information that a contextual target can absorb. The results locate word identity in the early layers of the language model, discourse state in the deeper layers, and make the choice of target layer a design dial for EEG language decoders.

arxiv.titleZh: 深层LLM层在默读时暴露EEG中的篇章级上下文
arxiv.summaryZh: 用逐层解码器把19通道静默阅读EEG对齐到Llama-3.1-8B全部33层隐状态，区分词级可解码性与上下文追踪成分。词级可解码性在浅层达到峰值并向末层递减，而上下文追踪随深度上升，且仅看单个0.5秒窗口的解码器也能追踪篇章。两项新控制——按各解码器词级准确率校准的目标几何合成预测器，以及跨同一或不同session打乱预测——表明上下文追踪既非词解码副产品，也非EEG记录session签名，而主要跟随文本。结果把词身份定位在LLM浅层、话语状态定位在深层，并提示目标层选择可作为EEG语言解码器的设计旋钮。

arxiv.title: Deconstructing Multi-Task Active Learning: The Paradox of Gradient Conflict and Orthogonal Decomposition
arxiv.abstract: Existing multi-task active learning (MTL-AL) methods predominantly rely on linear scalarization of heterogeneous objectives such as uncertainty, diversity, and gradient conflict. We argue that this entangled formulation is fundamentally limited, as linear combination fails to capture Pareto-optimal trade-offs under conflicting objectives. We propose a shift from combination to deconstruction and introduce a principled framework that rethinks MTL-AL along three orthogonal dimensions. First, we identify the Conflict Paradox: although the optimization literature treats gradient conflict as interference to be suppressed, penalizing conflict when ranking candidates is measurably worse than not scoring it at all. We therefore decouple the two concerns: the acquisition function does not score conflict, and the resulting interference is resolved by gradient surgery during training. Second, we introduce Orthogonal Decomposition, separating acquisition into Informativeness and Exploration. This two-stage process, informativeness filtering followed by coverage maximization, prevents "diversity dilution" by excluding uninformative outliers before enforcing diversity. Third, we propose Cross-Task Mutual Information (CTMI), a covariance-based statistic of cross-task dependency computed from MC-dropout task entropies. Extensive experiments on COCO, Cityscapes, and NYUv2, including comparisons against recent MTL-AL and data-selection baselines, demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, highlighting that structural rethinking of acquisition yields larger gains than incremental heuristic design. Code is available at https://github.com/Juho-Jung/multitask_active_learning_official.
arxiv.titleZh: 解构多任务主动学习：梯度冲突的悖论与正交分解
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有多任务主动学习把不确定性、多样性与梯度冲突等异质目标做线性标量化，难以刻画冲突目标下的 Pareto 最优权衡。工作转而将采集过程拆解为三个正交维度：指出「冲突悖论」——在候选排序阶段惩罚梯度冲突反而劣于完全不考虑冲突，于是采集函数不再对冲突打分，改由训练阶段的梯度手术消解干扰；提出正交分解，把采集分为信息量过滤与覆盖度最大化两阶段，避免无信息离群点造成的「多样性稀释」；并给出基于 MC-dropout 任务熵协方差的跨任务互信息统计量。在 COCO、Cityscapes、NYUv2 上相较近期 MTL-AL 与数据选择基线取得一致提升，说明采集机制的结构性重构比启发式微调更有效。

arxiv.title: GRAFT-EEG: Gauge-Aware Physical Field Transport for Cross-Dataset Motor-Imagery EEG
arxiv.abstract: Cross-dataset EEG decoding often treats montage, reference, and active-sensor changes as representation shift, although they also alter the observation operator. We study target-statistics-blind transfer: fitting receives no target signal, label, or empirical statistic, and electrode coordinates only instantiate a fixed prediction operator. method removes the active-set common-reference gauge and transports each native mask through a template motor leadfield. A source-fitted spectral classifier anchors the decision; a bounded state-space-model (SSM) residual is secondary. We establish restricted identifiability and an operator-perturbation bound. Across five leave-one-dataset-out targets (253 participants), dynamic method achieved 60.865% equal-target balanced accuracy versus 52.684% for strict-clean 5/5 BIOT (hierarchical difference +8.182 points; 95% CI +6.382 to +10.196; positive in every target). On four EEGPT-clean targets, the descriptive means were 61.520% and 59.057%. In four post-hoc exact same-parent tests, FULL exceeded coordinate-basis, matched-spectrum, row-shuffled, and wrong-anatomy controls by 9.959, 9.698, 11.241, and 3.985 points, respectively (all 95% CIs excluded zero; Holm-adjusted P<0.001). A separate 60-participant same-paradigm evaluation retained a positive physical-operator contrast (+4.029 points; +2.338 to +5.773), whereas dynamic--static was inconclusive; its preregistered status is partial confirmation rather than unrestricted external validation. The SSM added +1.059 points (+0.013 to +1.892). Claims remain bounded to five binary motor-imagery domains and the tested operators.
arxiv.titleZh: GRAFT-EEG:用于跨数据集运动想象脑电的规范感知物理场传输
arxiv.summaryZh: 跨数据集脑电解码通常把电极布局、参考方式与有源传感器的变化视为表征漂移，但这些变化同时改变了观测算子;该工作研究不接触目标统计量的迁移设定，即拟合阶段不使用目标域信号、标签或经验统计量。方法先去除有源电极公共参考的规范自由度，再将每个原生蒙版经模板运动导联场传输，以源域拟合的频谱分类器为主决策、有界状态空间模型（SSM）残差为辅，并给出受限可辨识性与算子扰动界。五个留一数据集目标（253名被试）上达到60.865%等目标平衡准确率，较严格清洗的5/5 BIOT的52.684%高8.182个百分点（95% CI +6.382~+10.196，各目标均为正）。

arxiv.title: ThetreStageAI: Multi-View Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Bengali Theatre Production Planning
arxiv.abstract: Staging a theatre performance requires coordinating dialogue, actor movement, stage directions, lighting focus, cue timing, and equipment constraints within the same production plan. This work presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning. Rather than retrieving from one mixed corpus, the system maintains separate scene, actor-blocking, and lighting views. Bengali text is embedded with BGE-M3 and indexed in view-specific Qdrant collections. Retrieved references are combined with a production brief and passed to Gemini, which generates schema-constrained JSON containing characters, scenes, dialogue, stage directions, blocking, lighting, and optional sound cues. Structural and semantic checks are applied before acceptance, with at most one constrained repair attempt. We also construct a human-guided, LLM-assisted synthetic dataset of 500 short Bengali theatre records that expands to 1,500 retrieval documents. Dataset diagnostics confirm consistent identifiers and valid lighting fields while also revealing substantial dialogue repetition. A paired camera-ready evaluation compares single-combined and full multi-view retrieval under matched settings. The source code, dataset, and evaluation materials are publicly available.

arxiv.titleZh: ThetreStageAI：面向结构化孟加拉语戏剧制作规划的多视图检索增强生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 戏剧排演需要把对白、演员走位、舞台指示、灯光焦点、cue时序与设备约束统一进同一份制作方案。该系统按场景、走位、灯光分别建立检索视图，用BGE-M3嵌入孟加拉语文本并写入Qdrant的视图专属集合，检索结果与制作简报一并送入Gemini，生成含角色、场景、对白、舞台指示、走位、灯光与可选音效cue的schema约束JSON，接受前做结构与语义校验，至多一次受限修复。作者构建了500条人工引导、LLM辅助的合成孟加拉语戏剧记录并扩展为1500条检索文档，诊断显示标识符一致、灯光字段合法但对白重复明显，并在匹配设置下成对比较单混合视图与完整多视图检索。工作面向低资源语言的垂直领域结构化生成，多视图检索的组织方式对领域RAG有参考价值。

arxiv.title: GEMS: Molecular Structure Elucidation as Learned Search over Isomer Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Identifying small-molecule structures from molecular formulas and tandem mass spectra remains a bottleneck in untargeted metabolomics and natural-product discovery. Even when database retrieval or de novo prediction misses the exact structure, the resulting candidates can provide starting points for exploring nearby structures through a few bond edits. We introduce GEMS (Guided Editing of Molecular Structures), which refines candidates through learned 2-switch bond edits that preserve the molecular formula and each atom's total valence. GEMS uses MIST, a pretrained spectrum-to-fingerprint model, to predict fingerprint probabilities once per spectrum. A neural policy compares each candidate's fingerprint with these predictions, links present features to the atoms and bonds that generate them, and scores all valid edits in one forward pass. The policy is trained on shortest edit paths between structures, so it can be pretrained on PubChem isomers without spectra and then fine-tuned with spectrum-predicted fingerprints. At inference, GEMS searches from multiple initial candidates matching the supplied molecular formula and ranks candidates by fingerprint agreement and multi-start consensus. With the target structure excluded from PubChem initialization, three edit rounds achieve Hit@1/Hit@10 of 29.64%/50.81% on NPLIB1 and 30.22%/41.33% on MassSpecGym, exceeding published baselines under comparable settings. On NPLIB1, GEMS achieves higher identification accuracy in about 3.3 minutes end to end, compared with 26.2 hours for our FRIGID run. GEMS also improves identification from generated candidates, including those refined by FRIGID. Experiments with exact target fingerprints identify fingerprint prediction error as a bottleneck in target recovery and final ranking. Deeper search recovers additional targets without retraining, with larger gains from weaker initial candidates.
arxiv.titleZh: GEMS：将分子结构解析建模为同分异构体图上的学习式搜索
arxiv.summaryZh: 从分子式与串联质谱鉴定小分子结构，数据库检索或 de novo 预测常会错过目标结构，但候选物可通过少量键编辑逼近真值。GEMS 将结构精修建模为保持分子式与原子总价不变的 2-switch 键编辑搜索:用预训练的 MIST 谱图到指纹模型为每个谱图预测一次指纹概率，再由神经策略比较候选指纹与预测、把特征关联到生成它的原子与键，并在一次前向中为所有合法编辑打分;策略以结构间最短编辑路径训练，可先在无谱图的 PubChem 同分异构体上预训练，再用谱图预测指纹微调。推理时从多个与分子式相符的初始候选项多起点搜索，按指纹一致性与多起点共识重排。将目标结构排除于 PubChem 初始化之外时，三轮编辑在 NPLIB1 与 MassSpecGym 上分别达到 Hit@1/Hit@10 29.64%/50.81% 与 30.22%/41.33%，优于同等设定下的已发表基线;NPLIB1 上端到端约 3.3 分钟即取得更高准确率，而 FRIGID 运行需 26.2 小时，且 GEMS 能改进生成候选(含 FRIGID 精修后的候选)。用精确目标指纹的实验定位出指纹预测误差是目标恢复与最终排序的瓶颈，加深搜索可在不重训的情况下找回更多目标，初始候选越弱收益越大。该工作处于质谱分子结构解析这一垂直领域，与 LLM 方向基本无交集。

arxiv.title: The Sign Code: The Hidden Binary Nature of Deep Networks
arxiv.abstract: Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer, training accuracy remains high, but test performance collapses. A margin decomposition helps explain these results: the sign-only contribution to each logit grows as $\sqrt{d}$ in network width, dominating the magnitude residual. The natural unit of analysis for these networks may not be through their continuous weight space but instead through their discrete sign codes.
arxiv.titleZh: 符号代码:深度网络隐藏的二元本质
arxiv.summaryZh: 将训练后网络中每个神经元的输出拆分为符号(正负)与幅值(绝对值)，并把全体神经元符号的集合称为「符号代码」，考察分类究竟依赖符号还是幅值。对采用保号激活函数的过参数化视觉分类器，仅在该二值符号代码上运行 k 近邻分类，即可在不同架构、激活函数与数据集上取得与完整模型相当的准确率;保留符号而把各层幅值替换为随机噪声几乎不改变残差网络性能，但只翻转 20% 的符号就会使准确率跌至随机水平。同类输入共享相似的符号代码时模型泛化良好，用正则项破坏这种重叠后训练准确率仍高而测试性能崩溃。margin 分解表明，仅符号部分对 logit 的贡献随网络宽度以 √d 增长，从而主导幅值残差。
arxiv.reason: 深度网络表征与泛化理论分析，与 LLM 架构方向擦边，分量有限

arxiv.title: Trajectory-Triggered Sparse Collaborative Decoding
arxiv.abstract: Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top-$k$ mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. Used online, learned sparse collaborative decoding improves over the best open-loop schedule by +5.3 to +20.0 accuracy points across five GSM8K draft-target pairs. On MATH-500, it gains 7.0-13.5 points when early prediction and target competence align, but loses when either is weak. On StrategyQA, it improves over open-loop by 5.0-8.3 points, showing transfer beyond arithmetics.

arxiv.titleZh: 轨迹触发的稀疏协同解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究稀疏协同解码中目标模型何时介入的问题:草稿模型生成大部分 token，目标模型仅用于短纠错片段。作者发现熵、NLL、logit margin、top-k mass 等局部不确定性特征几乎无法预测失败(AUC 0.50–0.53)，而草稿置信度路径上的轨迹形状聚合特征配合轻量 logistic 预测器可达 AUC 0.86，并由此揭示触发时机的杠杆—证据权衡。在线使用时，该方法在五个 GSM8K 草稿—目标模型组合上比最佳开环调度提升 5.3–20.0 个准确率点，MATH-500 上在早期预测与目标能力匹配时提升 7.0–13.5 点，StrategyQA 上提升 5.0–8.3 点。

arxiv.title: SIT-Eval: Situation-Based Interactive Turn-by-Turn Evaluation of Conversational Agents
arxiv.abstract: The rapid proliferation of conversational AI agents necessitates evaluation methods that assess performance across diverse dialogue scenarios, utilizing multiple situational criteria, as appropriate behavior depends on context and encompasses various aspects. Existing dialogue benchmarks typically use static natural conversations, which underrepresent rare situations---a critical safety gap, as low-probability events become frequent failures at production scale. However, limited sample sizes force a choice: either maintain natural dialogues for realism or turn to adaptive situation sampling for comprehensive yet statistically reliable coverage. We introduce SIT-Eval, an adjustable framework for evaluating situation-based conversational agents. We formalize an agent's desired behavior as situational rules: if situation is P, follow rules Q. At each conversation turn, an LLM-interlocutor enacts a uniformly sampled situation. A context-aware LLM-judge leverages all conditionally applicable rules as criteria to evaluate the agent's reply for that situation. The judge is validated using human-verified synthetic golden dialogues. Benchmarking 8 LLMs on 1292 conversation turns reveals failure modes hidden by aggregate metrics: models with similar overall scores vary widely in their adherence to individual rules. All models struggle most with ambiguity clarification and Socratic questioning.
arxiv.titleZh: SIT-Eval:面向对话智能体的基于情境的逐轮交互式评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有对话 benchmark 多依赖静态自然对话，稀有情境覆盖不足;而样本量限制又迫使真实性与覆盖范围二选一。SIT-Eval 将智能体的期望行为形式化为情境规则(若情境为 P，则遵循规则 Q):每轮由 LLM 对话者执行均匀采样的情境，再由上下文感知的 LLM judge 以所有条件适用的规则为 criteria 逐轮评分，judge 本身用人工校验的合成 golden 对话验证。在 8 个 LLM、1292 个对话轮次上，总体分数相近的模型在单条规则遵守度上差异显著，所有模型在歧义澄清与苏格拉底式提问上表现最差。该框架暴露出聚合指标掩盖的失败模式，适用于对话智能体与 Agent 的细粒度评测。

arxiv.title: How Many, but How Sure? Class Competition as a Confidence Proxy in Multi-Class Density-Based Counting
arxiv.abstract: Multi-class density estimators can count objects in crowded scenes, but their class-wise outputs offer no indication of how reliably density mass has been allocated. We introduce a training-free confidence proxy based on local competition between the strongest class channels. The resulting prominence measure requires only the predicted density maps, with no retraining or access to model internals. We test whether residual competition is diagnostic of cross-class leakage by attenuating contested density at inference time. On DSACA predictions for the Hicks et al. dataset, this reduces overall MAE from 0.920 to 0.846, suggesting that class competition contains useful information about count reliability.

arxiv.titleZh: 数量多少，但有多确定？类间竞争作为多类密度计数中的置信度代理
arxiv.summaryZh: 多类密度估计器能对拥挤场景计数，但其类别输出无法说明密度质量分配的可靠程度。提出免训练的置信度代理:利用最强类别通道之间的局部竞争构造 prominence 度量，仅依赖预测密度图，无需重训练或访问模型内部。在 Hicks 等人的数据集上，对 DSACA 预测在推理阶段衰减争议密度，整体 MAE 由 0.920 降至 0.846，表明类间竞争蕴含计数可靠性信息。

arxiv.title: When Magnitude Suffices: Reconstructing Time-Domain-Gated Microwave Signals Without Phase on a Thoracic Phantom
arxiv.abstract: Time-domain gating separates the arrivals that form a microwave S-parameter measurement. It requires the measurement of complex values, so this application almost always uses a vector network analyzer (VNA). We show that, on one calibrated measurement configuration, the gated magnitude the VNA would give can be reconstructed from a magnitude-only sweep of a spectrum analyzer with a tracking generator (SA). We select the gate center for separability of the measured states, correct each instrument once by a per-bin subtraction of a reference state, and train a fully connected network on sweeps from both instruments. The test object is a torso phantom with lung-shaped compartments whose filling takes eleven dielectric states, each held out in turn. On $S_{11}$ the reconstruction from SA input reaches a shape error of 0.08 dB$^2$ with a state ordering of 0.81. This matches the reconstruction from VNA input. On $S_{21}$ it reaches 0.82 dB$^2$ and keeps the ordered groups of the states. An explicit phase prediction performs much worse, because gating needs the phase to about 0.2 rad RMS. Across eleven measurement configurations the dependence of phase on magnitude is strong for reflection and weak for transmission. This explains the difference between $S_{11}$ and $S_{21}$. Where the magnitude carries enough of the phase, a scalar instrument gives the gated response without any phase measurement after installation. On the open UM-BMID breast data set, with whole phantoms held out, the shape error of the network is 30 percent lower than that of a per-bin linear map.
arxiv.titleZh: 当幅度足够时：在胸腔体模上无相位重建时域门控微波信号
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对微波S参数时域门控依赖矢量网络分析仪测量复数、必须获得相位的问题，用带跟踪发生器的频谱仪仅做幅度扫频，并训练全连接网络重建门控幅度响应。方法包括按状态可分性选择门中心、对各仪器逐频点做参考态减法校正，以及学习两种仪器扫频间的映射。在含肺形腔、十一种介电状态的胸腔体模上，S11形状误差0.08 dB²、状态排序0.81，与VNA输入相当；S21为0.82 dB²并保持状态分组；显式相位预测更差，因门控约需0.2 rad RMS相位精度。反射中相位对幅度依赖强、透射弱，在UM-BMID乳腺数据上形状误差较逐频点线性映射低30%。

arxiv.title: From Trajectories to Differentiated Skills: Cognitive Differentiation for Self-Improving Agents
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents tackle complex tasks through reasoning and interaction with external environments. Agent skills provide persistent, transferable capabilities that guide task planning, inform contextual decisions, support tool use, and enable executable procedures. Yet existing skill-evolution methods largely organize knowledge around skill artifacts, overlooking the functional heterogeneity within individual skills and its implications for knowledge maintenance and use. Inspired by cognitive science, we propose Cognitive Differentiation in Skill Evolution (CDSE), which evolves a unified skill through four functionally distinct yet coordinated components: Meta, Experience, Tool, and Script. CDSE extracts evidence-grounded semantic gradients from successful and failed trajectories, consolidates them by functional role, and applies component-specific updates and validation with cross-component coordination and adaptive invocation. An analysis of 500 top-ranked skill packages shows that 96.8% contain knowledge spanning at least two functional roles. Across six benchmarks, three agent models, and two execution harnesses, CDSE achieves the highest scores in all 36 settings, improving over the Base agent by 7.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method in each setting by 2.6 points on average. Ablation studies further support the importance of functional differentiation and adaptive invocation.
arxiv.titleZh: 从轨迹到分化技能：面向自我改进智能体的认知分化
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有技能演化方法以技能产物为单位组织知识，忽视单个技能内部的功能异质性。受认知科学启发，提出 CDSE，将统一技能拆为 Meta、Experience、Tool、Script 四个功能互补的组件，从成功与失败轨迹中抽取有证据支撑的语义梯度，按功能角色归并，再做组件级更新与验证、跨组件协调和自适应调用。在 6 个 benchmark、3 个模型、2 套执行 harness 共 36 种设置中全部取得最高分，平均较 Base 智能体提升 7.6 个百分点，较最强对比方法提升 2.6 个百分点。该工作为智能体技能演化与自我改进提供了可拆解的功能化框架。
arxiv.reason: Agent 技能演化与自我改进，方法系统、实验覆盖全面

arxiv.title: RL-Guided Temporal Localization for Dual-Channel Retrieval in Long-Horizon Agent Memory
arxiv.abstract: Time-aware retrieval is crucial for long-horizon LLM agents to effectively leverage ever-growing long-term memory. Existing methods focus on lexical or semantic similarity, leading to target memories being crowded out by temporally mismatched yet semantically similar candidates. Even time-aware approaches inject temporal cues only during memory organization or answer generation, overlooking temporal constraints at the retrieval stage, where candidate selection occurs - the root cause of the displacement. Inspired by the temporal contiguity effect in human episodic memory, we propose TIDER (Temporal Interval-driven Dual-channel Evidence Retrieval), a time-aware agentic retrieval framework. Central to TIDER is a reinforcement learning (RL)-trained temporal interval locator that infers the temporal windows in which the evidence lies. RL optimizes window localization as a discrete, non-differentiable retrieval decision, using composite rewards to convert sparse answer supervision into fine-grained retrieval feedback. These temporal windows first define the temporal retrieval channel; the retrieved candidates are then merged with results from the semantic channel and reranked by proximity to the windows. This temporal grounding enables TIDER to retrieve temporally aligned evidence that would otherwise be drowned out by the volume of semantically similar yet temporally mismatched memories. With a lightweight 1.7B locator, TIDER achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on both long-horizon memory benchmarks - 61.52% on LifeBench (+8.82%) and 78.96% on LoCoMo (+3.66%) - which indicates that temporal cues are crucial for pinpointing target evidence amid a vast pool of semantically similar historical events in long-term daily-life memory.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向长时程Agent记忆双通道检索的RL引导时间定位
arxiv.summaryZh: 长时程LLM Agent的记忆检索常被语义相似但时间不匹配的候选挤占，且现有方法只在记忆组织或答案生成阶段注入时间线索，忽略了检索阶段的时间约束。TIDER将时间约束前移到检索阶段：用RL训练一个1.7B的时间区间定位器，把窗口定位建模为离散、不可微的检索决策，并以复合奖励把稀疏的答案监督转成细粒度检索反馈；定位出的时间窗定义时间通道，与语义通道结果合并后按与窗口的邻近度重排。在LifeBench上达到61.52%（+8.82%），在LoCoMo上达到78.96%（+3.66%），表明时间线索对从海量语义相似的历史事件中定位证据起关键作用。
arxiv.reason: Agent记忆检索与RL训练定位器结合，命中Agent与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Boundary Detection for High-Dimensional Point Clouds
arxiv.abstract: We introduce two new methods for boundary detection in high-dimensional point cloud data, intended to work in situations with non-uniform density, high ambient dimension, and substantial noise. Our first method fits a separating hyperplane on local neighborhoods after doing local dimension reduction---this method works best when one can reliably estimate the intrinsic dimension of the data. Our second method measures the directional uniformity of local neighborhoods, and has the best overall performance on synthetic data. In addition to pointwise numerical boundary scores, our algorithms yield an estimated normal vector at each boundary point. We validate our methodology on synthetic data as well as two real examples: we analyze spatial transcriptomics data, where we show that we can detect the boundary of a tumor, and we also study LLM activation geometry.
arxiv.titleZh: 高维点云的边界检测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对非均匀密度、高环境维度且噪声显著的高维点云，提出两种边界检测方法:一种先在局部邻域做降维，再在邻域内拟合分离超平面，依赖对内在维度的可靠估计;另一种度量局部邻域的方向均匀性，在合成数据上综合表现最好。两种方法除输出逐点数值边界分数外，还给出边界点处的法向量估计。方法在合成数据与两个真实案例上验证:空间转录组数据中的肿瘤边界检测，以及 LLM 激活几何分析。
arxiv.reason: 流形几何统计方法，仅以 LLM 激活几何为应用示例，与后训练主线无关

arxiv.title: Analyzing Occupational Gender Bias across the LLM Training Lifecycle
arxiv.abstract: Post-training is widely assumed to reduce the social biases language models inherit from pretraining, yet direct evidence for this assumption remains mixed. In this paper, we examine how gender disparities evolve across the language modeling pipeline. In particular, we study occupational gender bias in OLMo 3, a fully open language model family, across its post-training stages by prompting each checkpoint to generate open-ended narratives about synthetic personas given their occupation and education. We consider two settings, a gender-given setting in which the profile states the persona's gender explicitly and a gender-assumed setting in which it must be inferred by the model. We find that when gender is stated, post-training increases semantic diversity for male-coded profiles, whereas for female-coded profiles the increase is smaller after SFT and not significant after DPO and RLVR. When gender is assumed by the model, post-training affects narratives about female and male personas similarly. The model's own gender assumptions, however, show a consistent female-preferential skew relative to United States labor-force demographics, except for heavily male-dominated occupations. Every successive post-training stage monotonically increases the odds of attributing a female label over the base model. A provenance analysis of the supervised fine-tuning corpus finds only a modest 7.7% female-token surplus, too small to explain the size of these downstream effects. The project code is available under: https://github.com/manthangadhia/llm-lifecycle-bias.
arxiv.comment: Submitted to 7th Workshop on Gender Bias in Natural Language Processing @AACL-IJCNLP 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 分析LLM训练生命周期中的职业性别偏见
arxiv.summaryZh: 沿OLMo 3完整开源训练链路(基座→SFT→DPO→RLVR)逐检查点生成职业与教育人设的开放式叙事，在「性别显式给出」与「性别由模型推断」两种设定下测量职业性别偏见。结果显示:性别明示时，后训练只提升男性编码画像的语义多样性，女性编码画像在SFT后提升有限、DPO与RLVR后不显著;模型自行假定性别时对男女画像影响相近，但整体相对美国劳动力人口呈女性偏好偏移，且每个后训练阶段都单调提高赋予女性标签的几率。对SFT语料溯源仅发现7.7%的女性token盈余，不足以解释该下游效应。为「后训练能否降低偏见」这一假设提供了直接的检查点级证据。
arxiv.reason: 逐阶段剖析后训练性别偏见，属性别与评测向，方法增量有限

arxiv.title: MARS: Memory-Aware Routing for Session-Level LLM Assistants
arxiv.abstract: Long-term LLM assistants must repeatedly decide what prior context to expose and which model should answer as an interaction evolves. Existing memory systems and model routers usually make these decisions separately, although memory construction changes the evidence, distractors, and difficulty of the resulting input. We introduce MARS, a memory-aware routing framework that uses session state as a shared control interface between memory construction and model selection. A Query and Topic Manager (QTM) estimates compact decision-relevant state that guides a fixed state-conditioned memory policy and an online router, enabling each turn to receive an appropriate memory view and a suitable model under a quality-memory-cost trade-off. We evaluate MARS on RealMem and MultiChallenge with 16 system configurations each, covering long-history memory-driven interaction and bounded sessions with structured context interference. On RealMem, MARS preserves 98.2% of full-context GPT-4o's QA while using only 14.5% of its generation API cost, including both generation and controller calls for MARS, and achieves the strongest measured memory-recall and retrieval scores among compared systems. On MultiChallenge, MARS trails the strongest static system overall but approaches its performance at lower recorded cost on a mechanism-focused subset. Together, these results support a favorable quality-memory-cost trade-off for long-history, memory-dependent interaction.
arxiv.titleZh: MARS：面向会话级 LLM 助手的记忆感知路由
arxiv.summaryZh: 长期 LLM 助手在每轮交互中需分别决定暴露哪些历史上下文、由哪个模型作答，而现有记忆系统与模型路由器各自独立决策，忽视了记忆构建会改变输入的证据、干扰项与难度。MARS 以会话状态作为记忆构建与模型选择的共享控制接口，由 Query and Topic Manager（QTM）估计紧凑的决策相关状态，进而驱动固定的状态条件记忆策略与在线路由器，在质量、记忆与成本之间权衡。在 RealMem 上保留全上下文 GPT-4o 98.2% 的问答性能，仅消耗其 14.5% 的生成 API 成本，记忆召回与检索得分在对比系统中最高；在 MultiChallenge 上整体略逊于最强静态系统，但在机制相关子集上以更低记录成本接近其表现。
arxiv.reason: 记忆构建与模型路由联合优化，命中 Agent 记忆与效率方向
